behavior: The tab stop is on the active tab, also when that tab is disabled. With no active tab, it is on the first tab. A disabled tab takes the focus and has `aria-disabled="true"`, so Tab enters the list at the tab whose panel shows, as the WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices describe. Base UI gives a disabled tab that a script selected no tab stop. It moves the tab stop of a removed active tab to the next tab.
